triplets.subject: State Bank of India (SBI) Internal Audit Division
triplets.evidence: Preliminary internal audits conducted by SBI officials in early April 1992 revealed massive discrepancies in their Subsidiary General Ledger (SGL) accounts held with the Reserve Bank of India's Public Debt Office (PDO).

triplets.subject: Incident Details
triplets.evidence: A shortfall of approximately ₹500 crore was detected. Further investigation revealed that between July 1, 1991, and April 6, 1992, Harshad Mehta was involved in SBI transactions totaling over ₹17,000 crore, with funds credited directly to his account without corresponding SGL entries in SBI's books.
